Core.notes: Language core; exercised by most compatibility tests. Missing get_resource_id(), get_resources(), get_mangled_object_vars(), zend_version() and clone(), some attribute and exception classes, and build-path constants. gc_mem_caches() and memory_reset_peak_usage() are no-ops.

standard.notes: Broadly implemented and exercised by most compatibility tests. About 50 functions are missing (DNS, syslog, get_browser, get_headers and others); several process and output helpers are no-ops.

SPL.notes: Data structures, iterators and autoloading are widely tested. SplObserver, SplSubject, OuterIterator, SeekableIterator, ParentIterator and RecursiveCachingIterator are not defined, and the file iterators and SplFileObject lack a number of methods.

json.notes: json_encode(), json_decode() and json_validate() are covered by differential tests. Several JSON_ERROR_* constants are not defined.

pcre.notes: All preg_* functions are implemented on PCRE2 and covered by differential tests. PCRE_JIT_SUPPORT is not defined.

PDO.notes: Tested against SQLite in-process and MySQL and PostgreSQL servers in CI. pdo_drivers() and PDORow are missing.

pdo_sqlite.notes: Tested in-process by the compatibility and PDO suites. Some Pdo\Sqlite methods are missing.

pdo_mysql.notes: Tested against a MySQL server by the PDO suite. Pdo\Mysql driver-specific methods are not implemented.

pdo_pgsql.notes: Tested against a PostgreSQL server by the PDO suite. Pdo\Pgsql driver-specific methods are not implemented.

session.notes: Session functions exist but have little differential coverage; SessionHandler is missing.

mbstring.notes: Common mb_* string functions are implemented; the mb_ereg* family, MIME header and kana conversion functions are missing.

filter.notes: filter_var() and friends are implemented with limited test coverage; several flags and the Filter\ exception classes are missing.

hash.notes: hash(), hash_hmac(), incremental hashing and the common algorithms are covered by tests. hash_update_stream() is missing.

iconv.notes: Implemented without differential test coverage; iconv_get_encoding() and iconv_set_encoding() are missing.

tokenizer.notes: token_get_all(), token_name() and PhpToken with every T_* constant; covered by a small number of tests.

Reflection.notes: The class, method, property, parameter and attribute reflection frameworks rely on works, but a number of methods are missing and some details differ from PHP.

date.notes: date(), strtotime(), DateTime and time zones are widely tested; sunrise/sunset, transition listings and some DateTimeImmutable, DateInterval and DatePeriod methods are missing.

openssl.notes: Only symmetric encryption, digests, random bytes and a few helpers are implemented; key, certificate, CSR, PKCS and CMS functions are missing.

curl.notes: The easy and multi interfaces cover common HTTP use; share handles, pausing and most CURL* constants are missing.

sodium.notes: About half of the sodium_* functions are implemented, with little differential coverage.

ldap.notes: About half of the ldap_* functions exist, mostly untested; the LDAP\ handle classes are missing.

ftp.notes: Most ftp_* functions exist but are essentially untested; FTP\Connection is missing.

gd.notes: Image creation, drawing and PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP I/O are implemented; about 60% of the image* functions are missing.

gmp.notes: Arithmetic and comparison are implemented and tested; import/export, random and several number-theory functions are missing.

bcmath.notes: Every bc* function and BcMath\Number are implemented; tests cover the common operations.

libxml.notes: Error handling helpers are implemented; the external entity loader and stream context functions are missing.

dom.notes: The legacy DOM classes cover common document building and querying; the Dom\ HTML5 API and many methods are missing.

SimpleXML.notes: Loading, traversal and XPath work; several SimpleXMLElement methods are missing.

xml.notes: The xml_parser_* API exists but is barely tested; namespace and entity handlers are missing.

xmlreader.notes: XMLReader covers forward reading; some methods are missing.

xmlwriter.notes: Element, attribute and text writing work; DTD, PI and namespaced attribute writing are missing.

intl.notes: Normalizer, number and date formatting, transliteration and a few other classes exist; most of the procedural API, Collator, IntlChar and the calendar classes are incomplete.

fileinfo.notes: finfo and mime_content_type() are implemented with minimal test coverage; results may differ from libmagic.

Phar.notes: Phar classes exist for reading archives; most archive-writing and metadata methods are missing.

soap.notes: SoapClient and SoapServer classes exist but are barely tested; is_soap_fault() and use_soap_error_handler() are missing.

zlib.notes: gzcompress, gzencode, gzdeflate and the gz* file functions work; incremental deflate/inflate contexts and several helpers are missing.

posix.notes: Process, user and group lookups are implemented; file, access and privilege functions and every POSIX_* constant are missing.

pcntl.notes: Fork, wait, exec and signal handling exist with little test coverage; priority, affinity and sigwait functions are missing.

random.notes: The random functions and Randomizer are implemented; the Random\ exception classes, IntervalBoundary and some engine and Randomizer methods are missing.
